about: Numbers for the optional sleep training mode (services/training.py). Each number is from a published trial or review; the app stores the numbers and a link. The scale goes from 1 (gentle) to 10 (firm); 5 is the usual schedule of the trials.

graduated.about: Waits before each check, in minutes: gentle = a fixed 2 minutes; usual = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 (Hiscock 2008); firm = 5, 10, 15 (RACGP). No source gives a wait above 15 minutes.

presence.about: Parental presence. With graduated extinction: the parent moves away in steps (camping out). nights_per_step: gentle 4, usual 3, firm 1. With extinction: the parent stays in the room for 7 nights.
steps: Sit beside the bed. Pat or stroke {name} until asleep.
Sit beside the bed. Do not touch {name}. Use your voice only.
Move the chair about 1 metre away from the bed. Use your voice only.
Sit outside the door, where {name} cannot see you.

fading.about: Bedtime fading (Cooney 2018; Piazza 1991). Start 30 minutes after the usual time that the child falls asleep, for 2 nights. A good night: asleep in 15 minutes or less.
